title: Admission gate for Helm-rendered manifests
scenario: Tessellate is about to switch Binary Authorization on prod-blue from dry-run to enforce. Before that, the platform team wants the same decisions made in CI, on the output of helm template, so a chart fails in the pull request instead of at admission. A spike left a half-written gate.py; the security team wrote the rules (PLAT-1201).
task: Load helm template output: empty documents, comment-only documents, kind: List
Find every pod template (Deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet, Job, CronJob, Pod) and every container including init containers
Registry allow-list (Artifact Registry, prod project only), digest pinning, attestation by the required attestor
Pod hardening, resources, readiness probes, PDBs, Workload Identity Federation for GKE
Break-glass waives only the attestation rule and is reported as an audited exception; dry-run vs enforce exit codes
acceptance: The shipped render yields exactly the five expected findings; mdm-api is clean
Look-alike registry hosts and other projects are rejected; tag+digest counts as pinned
Attestations count only for the right attestor, digest and repository
Exit 0 in dry-run, 1 on violations in enforce, 2 on unparseable input

practices.label: Week 5 - Mon: Artifact Registry and Artifact Analysis
Week 5 - Tue: Binary Authorization and SLSA
Week 5 - Wed: GKE hardening and Workload Identity Federation for GKE
